🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Wetter (Weather)

die Sonne = sun
der Regen = rain
der Schnee = snow
der Wind = wind
die Wolke = cloud
das Gewitter = thunderstorm

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
